snapshot.title: Boil Water Advisory — Zone 2

fields.utility: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer
fields.contaminant: a loss of disinfection due to a break in the Hilltop Transmission Main and failure of telemetry from the Orchard Standpipe outlet
fields.affectedArea: All customers in Zone 2, including the Hilltop, Eastfield, and north-facing parts of downtown
fields.whatHappened: At 06:10, a 24-inch transmission main broke near Summit Drive, causing the Hilltop Tank to drain and Zone 2 to lose pressure. The chlorine residual at the Orchard Standpipe outlet (AIT-611) has been undetectable since 06:40. The system has been operating under manual control since 07:50, and the loss of disinfection has lasted 135 minutes.
whatToDo: DO NOT DRINK THE TAP WATER WITHOUT BOILING IT FIRST. Bring all water to a rolling boil for one minute, then cool before using for drinking, cooking, brushing teeth, or making ice.
DO NOT USE THE TAP WATER FOR BATHING, SHOWERING, OR LAUNDRY. BATHING IS PERMITTED FOR ADULTS BUT AVOID PROLONGED SKIN CONTACT.
USE BOTTLED WATER OR WATER FROM THE TANKER FILL POINTS AT NORTHGATE RESERVOIR (OPEN 09:00) AND HILLTOP TANK (OPEN 10:00) FOR ALL CONSUMPTION AND COOKING.
DO NOT GIVE TAP WATER TO PETS.
FLUSH COLD TAPS FOR 2–5 MINUTES BEFORE USING AFTER THE ADVISORY IS LIFTED.
fields.whatIsBeingDone: The city has isolated Zone 2 and restored disinfection via manual operations at the Mill Road Booster Station. The system is now under manual control with continuous sampling every two hours. The Ohio EPA, Carver County Public Health, and Millbrook Police are monitoring the situation. Flushing and recirculation are underway.
fields.expectedResolution: The advisory will remain in effect until two consecutive grab samples, taken 24 hours apart, confirm a detectable chlorine residual and no pathogens. The next update will be issued by 04:00 on October 25, 2026.
fields.languageNote: Este informe contiene información muy importante sobre su agua de beber. Tradúzcalo o hable con alguien que lo entienda bien.

snapshot.instructorNote: This is the official public release of the Boil Water Advisory. The PIO must confirm that the advisory has been distributed via MillbrookAlert, the website, and all social media channels. The Deputy PIO should now begin monitoring for rumors using the Section 10 template.
